places.name: Royal Palace of Madrid
places.ai_summary: A grand palace and official residence of the Spanish royal family, showcasing opulent architecture and rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during official events.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the queue.
places.address: Calle de Bailén, s/n, 28071 Madrid, Spain

places.name: Plaza Mayor
places.ai_summary: A historic square in the heart of Madrid, surrounded by stunning architecture and vibrant cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Try the local calamari sandwich at a nearby cafe.

places.name: Puerta del Sol
places.ai_summary: A bustling public square, considered the center of Madrid, known for the famous 'Bear and the Strawberry Tree' statue.

opening_hours.notes: Always lively, best visited at any time.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby shops and cafes.

places.name: Prado Museum
places.ai_summary: One of the world's premier art galleries, featuring works by Spanish masters like Velázquez and Goya.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on certain holidays.

places.place_tip: Check for free entry times.
places.address: Calle de Felipe IV, s/n, 28014 Madrid, Spain

places.name: Reina Sofía Museum
places.ai_summary: A modern art museum, home to Picasso's Guernica and other significant 20th-century artworks.

opening_hours.notes: Free entry on certain days and times.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum shop for unique souvenirs.
places.address: Calle de Santa Isabel, 52, 28012 Madrid, Spain

places.name: Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum
places.ai_summary: An art museum with a vast collection ranging from the Middle Ages to the 20th century, including works by Van Gogh and Monet.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on certain holidays.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the nearby Prado Museum.

places.ai_summary: A large and popular park in the city center, featuring the Crystal Palace, a glass pavilion that hosts art exhibitions.

opening_hours.notes: The park is open, but the Crystal Palace has specific exhibition hours.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy it by the lake.

places.name: Temple of Debod
places.ai_summary: An ancient Egyptian temple relocated to Madrid, offering stunning sunset views and a peaceful park setting.

places.place_tip: Check the sunset time and arrive early for a good spot.

places.name: Gran Vía
places.ai_summary: A major street in Madrid, known for its grand architecture, shopping, and vibrant nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Always lively, best visited at any time.

places.ai_summary: The main cathedral of Madrid, known for its stunning architecture and beautiful interior.

places.place_tip: Visit the dome for a panoramic view of the city.
